# Nemotron Ultra fixture rows

These JSON files preserve representative RDKit, tool-call schema, and SWE single-step action records. [`../../test_grader_binding.py`](../../test_grader_binding.py) uses the tool-call and SWE action examples to check the emitted private contracts and source-control behavior. The RDKit snapshots remain available for source-contract inspection.

See the [task curation tests](../../README.md) and [Ultra declarations](../../../datasets/README.md).
